capability: Native scoped RetailVantage connection readiness only; configure, provider test and sync blocked.
advisor_assessment: WARN/ERROR counts unchanged. INFO counts recorded; no index removed or existing policy/grant changes.
limits: Verified activated native identity and active same-org tenant admin required. Connector must be RetailVantage; optional org must agree.
Default/status returns connection/org IDs and blockers only. Imported refs/settings do not establish destination credential authority; no credential decryption.

Configure/test/sync returns HTTP 409 with executed=false, records_imported=0, sync_job_created=false, cursor_advanced=false, provider_verified=false. No Vault/config writes, OAuth/provider call, ingest/bridge call, job or connection marker change.

Full execution requires reviewed fresh destination credential/auth contract, approved HTTPS/token/redirect origins, allowlisted resources/same-origin pagination, bounded resumable pages/atomic checkpoints, stable source identity/dates/scope and truthful completion reconciliation.
Source absolute endpoint/pagination URLs can forward credentials; 100-page cap and initial-sync completion on partial results are not enabled.
No customer-data copy, hosted cutover, main merge, schedules, final source delta or source retirement.
